HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE RAVINDER DUDEJA  ORDER % 22.12.2025 CRL.M.A. 38428/2025 (corrections/modifications of orders)
1.

This is an application filed on behalf of the petitioner for modification of order dated 09.04.2025.
2.

It is submitted that there is a typographic error pertaining to the FIR no. in paragraphs no. 1, 10 and 11 in the order dated 09.04.2025 passed in criminal miscellaneous petition no. 2197/2025,
inasmuch as the correct FIR no. is 284/2016 and not 482/2016 as incorrectly recorded.
3.
The perusal of the record reveals that there is a typographic error in regarding the FIR no. in the judgment dated 09.04.2025.
The application is allowed and judgment dated 09.04.2025 is deemed to have been passed in case FIR no. 284/2016 PS Dwarka South, under Section 498A/406/34 IPC.
